items.speaker: I'm driving up to the lake on Saturday.

options.A: I hope the weather stays clear.
options.B: The lake usually freezes over in January.
options.C: I finished my laundry this morning.
options.D: No, I don't have a license.

items.explanation: A正确：对方在说周末的出行计划，回应他此行顺利、盼天气好，是最自然的接话。B错（semantic_association_trap）：抓住"lake"改说结冰的季节，与周六出行无关。C错（off_topic）：洗衣服完全是另一个话题。D错（wrong_question_type）：对方是陈述而非提问，用"No"否认无从谈起。

items.situation: two classmates discussing a group project deadline
items.speaker: Where are we supposed to upload the group slides?

options.A: The slides took us almost three whole days.
options.B: Your guess is as good as mine.
options.C: We should practice the timing more.

items.explanation: B正确："Your guess is as good as mine"是承认自己也不知道的固定说法，正好回应"上传到哪里"这个问题。A错（semantic_association_trap）：借"slides"转去讲做幻灯片花了多久，没回答地点。C错（off_topic）：练时间控制是另一件事，与上传位置无关。D错（wrong_question_type）：答的是截止时间，问的却是地点。

items.situation: expressing concern about a friend's situation
items.speaker: Why didn't you tell me about the hospital visit?

options.A: The hospital is near the station.
options.B: I visited my aunt last summer.
options.D: No, I can't tell them apart.

items.explanation: C正确："it slipped my mind"是"一时忘了"的惯用说法，直接解释了自己没说的原因。A错（semantic_association_trap）：抓住"hospital"改说医院位置，没回应对方的在意。B错（off_topic）：去年探望姑妈是另一件事。D错（polysemy_trap）：把"tell"误当成"分辨"，答的是分不清两者。

items.speaker: How come the shuttle doesn't run past midnight?

options.A: The shuttle stop moved there last term.
options.B: Yes, it runs every twenty minutes.
options.D: Budget cuts, from what I hear.

items.explanation: D正确："from what I hear"是"我听说是这样"的口语说法，给出了停运的原因又不越权断言。A错（semantic_association_trap）：借"shuttle"改讲站点搬迁，没解释原因。B错（wrong_question_type）：答的是发车频率，而且与"午夜后不开"矛盾。C错（off_topic）：自己走回家是个人做法，没回答为什么停运。

items.situation: two friends deciding where to get lunch
items.speaker: What are you in the mood for today?

options.C: The mood in there was tense.

items.explanation: A正确："Anything but…"是表达偏好的地道说法，回答了自己今天想吃什么（除了食堂都行）。B错（misinterpretation）：把"grab"理解成替对方买，可这是问对方想吃什么。C错（semantic_association_trap）：把"mood"当成气氛，答成别处的气氛紧张。D错（wrong_question_type）：问的是想吃什么，答的却是吃过没有。

items.situation: student asking about sports facility hours
items.speaker: Is the weight room open this late?

options.A: The weight room has new mirrors.
options.D: It costs twenty dollars a month.

items.explanation: B正确：不直接说"开"，而用"你还有十分钟"含蓄告知快关门了，是最自然的回应。A错（semantic_association_trap）：借"weight room"改说新装的镜子，没回答开没开。C错（off_topic）：自己忘带卡是别人的事。D错（wrong_question_type）：答的是会员费，问的是开放时间。

items.situation: student asking about a dorm maintenance issue
items.speaker: Didn't anyone come look at the broken window?

options.A: The window faces the north parking lot.
options.B: I broke my glasses last night.
options.C: They're on their way up now.

items.explanation: C正确："on their way up"告诉对方维修的人马上就到，正面接住了这句抱怨式提问。A错（semantic_association_trap）：抓住"window"改讲窗户朝向。B错（polysemy_trap）：把"broken"挪到眼镜上，答成自己弄坏了眼镜。D错（wrong_question_type）：答的是频率，问的是有没有人来过。

items.situation: asking a neighbor about noise from shared walls
items.speaker: Can't you hear the drilling from your side?

options.A: The drill belongs to the landlord.
options.B: I moved in here just three weeks ago.
options.D: Oh, that finally stopped an hour ago.

items.explanation: D正确：用"Oh"引出间接回应——那声音一小时前就停了，等于回答了"你那边听得到吗"。A错（semantic_association_trap）：抓住"drill"改说电钻归谁。B错（off_topic）：搬来多久与此刻听不听得到无关。C错（wrong_question_type）：答的是位置，问的是听不听得到。

items.situation: student checking with a TA about lab report requirements
items.speaker: When do you want the lab reports turned in?

options.B: The lab has three new microscopes.
options.C: I typed mine in the library.
options.D: Yes, you can hand them in.

items.explanation: A正确：以"Well"开头给出一个宽松的时间范围，正是对"什么时候交"的自然回答。B错（semantic_association_trap）：借"lab"改讲实验室新设备。C错（off_topic）：自己在哪里打的报告与截止时间无关。D错（wrong_question_type）：问的是时间，答的却是可不可以交。

items.situation: arranging a ride with a friend
items.speaker: I'll pick you up around seven then.

options.A: The car probably needs new tires soon.
options.B: Maybe half past would work better.
options.C: I picked up my package yesterday.

items.explanation: B正确：用"Maybe"缓和地提出改到七点半，既接住了安排又推进了对话。A错（semantic_association_trap）：抓住开车的场景改说轮胎该换了。C错（polysemy_trap）：把"pick up"当成取快递。D错（misinterpretation）：把时间"seven"误当成人数七个人。
